release.name: Frost
release.author: Izumi
release.description: Modelled on the AllAnime site: cool slate surfaces with a sky-blue accent and a top bar. The featured banner keeps the stock layout with white dots at the end; section titles are heavy with an arrow; posters carry a blue score badge. The watch page docks a centred player with the episode list beside it; the series page splits info and a thumbnail episode rail under pill tabs. Phones get a floating bottom bar with labels and a tonal pill.
